sourcePixelSection:
Opened this complete actual scratch PNG alone after freezing16.

Path: `.tmp/ld-s10y-lesson/10c/pages/0031/figures/fig-17.png`.
SHA256: `2635c2d39c0b80b6e232ce9716e668a6a7d28f0ec5d1e94ac489bb7e4a7b148b`.

- One comparatively tall Cartesian frame, no grid or subpanels. Horizontal solid axis has right arrow/x and extends left. Vertical y-axis has upper arrow/y and continues to below the negative troughs. The original -1 label is beside the lower trough level; no separate positive1 numeral is clearly printed. The oval below-left at the axes crossing is `ROUND-GLYPH-UNKNOWN`.
- Explicit positive x ticks/labels are pi/10 and pi/5. Their ticks align with the first and second positive SOLID maxima to the right of the central maximum, respectively; they are not solid zeros or troughs.
- Heavy SOLID `y = cos 20x` has five visible narrow positive crests, four visible negative troughs, and ten x-axis crossings counting its left/right finite zero endpoints. Central positive crest lies at the vertical axis. Every narrow lobe must be kept; compression is not an arbitrary attractive high-frequency wave.
- Thin DASHED `y = cos x` shows one broad positive arch, maximum near the vertical axis, staying above the horizontal axis throughout its visible span. Its left/right endpoints are positive and its path extends farther sideways than the solid zero endpoints. No dashed negative lobe or dashed axis crossing is visible and none may be added merely to complete a period.
- Solid/dashed meet around the central positive crest and cross on the shoulders of other narrow positive lobes. No crossing is point-labelled/dotted. The formula `y = cos 20x` is printed right of the last narrow positive lobe, and `y = cos x` next to the right dashed descending end; neither has a leader arrow.
- Curve endpoints, axes/arrows, tick marks, the full tall negative lobes, and the source relative horizontal scale must survive. There is no apparatus, dashed axis, or extra dimensional value.

Required later coverage: exact20 horizontal compression, both source function identities/solid-dash roles, full five-crest/four-trough solid path and finite endpoints, positive dashed-only interval, pi/10 and pi/5 on solid maxima, -1 scale and all source intersections. Do not treat this as the same domain/composition as16.
